target_customer: Retail prediction market traders who want parlay style combined bets, and apps building on the exchange
problem: Prediction markets offer single outcome bets, so traders cannot combine several outcomes into one payout without a venue's own parlay feature.
business_model: Exchange and derivative layer earning from combo trading, with market makers pricing combos

founders.name: Pravesh Mansharamani
education: Math, University of Waterloo (per YC page)

founders.name: Eric Liu
education: Math, University of Waterloo (per YC page)

competitors.name: Kalshi Combos
competitors.what: Multi-leg parlay style contracts on a CFTC regulated exchange, priced by request for quote
competitors.traction_then: Reported $14.0B of $84.2B notional volume since the 2025-09 launch (newsletter figure)

competitors.name: Polymarket Combos
competitors.what: User built multi-leg positions added after earlier prebuilt parlay markets
competitors.traction_then: Reported higher test volume than Kalshi parlays in the first days

competitors.name: Crypto.com combo betting
competitors.what: Combo bets on its prediction market product

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining event outcomes on chain with market maker quoting and vault settlement is standard crypto engineering with hard pricing and settlement parts.

defensibility.rationale: Kalshi and Polymarket already ship combos, so the wedge is a neutral layer with market maker liquidity. Liquidity could compound but features are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The big venues shipped combos from 2025-09 onward, before the Totalis launch in 2026.

market_need_then: Sports style parlays drove large volume on Kalshi after 2025-09, showing retail demand for multi-leg bets, though Bloomberg reported net customer losses on them.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct: 'Trade what happens next.'

branding.community_and_virality: Crypto news outlets covered the launch and the first YC investment paid in USDC, which was the main press hook.

brand_strength.rationale: Press focused on the USDC funding novelty rather than the brand. TOTALIS is also a registered insurance trademark and other Totalis entities exist.

outcome_analysis: Totalis raised a $500K seed paid in USDC and launched parlay trading in spring 2026, gaining crypto press. No shutdown, hack or regulatory action was found as of November 2026. It faces large venues that already ship combos, plus sector wide legal risk, so its outcome is open.
notes: PitchBook records a $510K seed on 2026-02-09 while news says $500K announced April 2026. Investors Night Capital and UFO Holdings come from PitchBook only. The company site says it is built on Hyperliquid HIP-4 while crypto press says Solana settlement, which conflicts. The YC page lists the founders without prior startups.
